extraction: dmux Workflows: orchestrate parallel AI agent sessions using dmux (tmux pane manager for agent harnesses). Supports Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Cline, Gemini, Qwen. Five patterns: 1) Research + Implement (parallel tracks), 2) Multi-File Feature (parallelize independent files), 3) Test + Fix Loop (watcher runs tests, fixer fixes), 4) Cross-Harness (different AI tools for different tasks), 5) Code Review Pipeline (parallel review perspectives). Best practices: independent tasks only, clear boundaries per pane, merge strategically, use git worktrees for file-conflict-prone work, keep total panes under 5-6. ECC helper: node scripts/orchestrate-worktrees.js with plan.json defining sessionName, baseRef, launcherCommand, workers with name/task. Creates branch-backed git worktree per worker, optionally overlays seedPaths, writes per-worker task.md/handoff.md/status.md under .orchestration/<session>/, starts tmux session with one pane per worker, launches worker command in each pane, leaves main pane for orchestrator.
